configuration.purpose: design case with the atlas seas and rain-fed lakes

evidence: ExoPlaSim 3-day output means at T21 (about 170 km cells) over the whole Moon. prc is the convection scheme's rain and pr all rain; the 3-day means average single storms out, so the maps describe where and how much the scheme convects, which a storm model must translate into storms.
reading_rule: Maps run [lat][lon] over the model grid (lat_deg north to south, lon_deg east from 0). Rain in mm per day of liquid water. prc_p15_mean and prc_p2_mean are the means of prc**1.5 and prc**2 with prc in mm/day. raining_share is the share of 3-day outputs with prc above raining_mm_day. land_share is the mean of the model's land-sea mask (1 land). cell_area_share sums to 1 over the Moon.
